answer: Counterparty diversity blocks fake identities: rewards unlock after fifty counterparties trade with an identity per epoch. The registry checks quartz-stamped receipts from unrelated wallets, so shipments between shells of one operator count as one counterparty, not fifty. An orchard of shells cannot certify itself: the k-th identity needs fifty outsiders, with no bulk discount. Forging 1,000 identities needs 50,000 timber trades, or 50,000 credits, growing linearly, while an honest agent pays fifty trades once. Counterparty rental fails: rented strangers leave a graph exposing the cluster.
